sources.quote: Startup Wise Guys | Investing In The Bold Ones Menu Close For Founders Startup Stages Building Programs for founders or teams just starting out and looking to validate their MVP. Growing Acceleration programs for teams building products and taking them to the market. Scaling Programs for scaleups growing with necessity to expand their market. Verticals Cybersecurity Defence and Security Fintech SaaS Proptech Sustainability Web3 Other Mentors For Investors About Portfolio All programs All programs Investing in the bold ones Global VC funds and accelerators for passionate B2B startup founders See all programs We help you to solve key challenges at every stage Dare to dream global. We’re a startup accelerator like no other, our optimized approach puts early-stage startups on the map and catapults them into worldwide success. Startup Wise Guys’ origins began in Europe’s tech-savvy startup capital, Estonia. Since 2012, we have used our carefully curated expertise, skills and funding to skyrocket hundreds of emerging early-stage startups into upwards growth. This is not our first rodeo… we are the most experienced accelerator fund in the region with over 45+ programs, an international community of founders from over 60 countries and an established market in CEE and CIS countries. Do you think you have what it takes? Ready to take the world by storm? The proof is in the pudding
